title: ‘Magpakatatag kayo’: Marcos honors PCG, vows readiness to face complex maritime challenges

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday expressed gratitude to the men and women of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), vowing to continue strengthening the agency’s capabilities and readiness to respond to “increasingly complex maritime challenges.”
